script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

EXT. SUBURBAN NEIGHBORHOOD - DAY

A beautiful, sunny day. Kids are playing in the streets, families are tending to their gardens.

NARRATOR (V.O.) (Father)
For years, my wife and I have lived in this quiet neighborhood, raising our three children. But lately, I've felt a growing distance between us.

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

The family gathers for breakfast. The father, MARK, looks at his wife, LUCY, with a mixture of love and frustration.

MARK
Lucy, we need to talk.

LUCY
Mark, not now. I'm trying to get the kids ready for school.

MARK
This can't wait. I need your help with something important.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Mark and Lucy sit down on the couch. The tension between them is palpable.

MARK
Lucy, I've been thinking a lot about our marriage lately. And I've come to a realization.

LUCY
What's that?

MARK
I've taken you for granted. I've let work consume me, and I've neglected you and the kids. I'm sorry.

LUCY
(sighs)
I've felt that for a long time, Mark. But I've been too afraid to say anything.

MARK
We can't keep going like this. We need to find a way to reconnect.

INT. FAMILY ROOM - DAY

Mark and Lucy sit together on the couch, looking at old family photos. They reminisce about happier times and laugh at the memories.

NARRATOR (V.O.) (Mark)
As the days passed, we made a conscious effort to reconnect. We spent more time together, went on dates, and even started a new tradition: family game nights.

INT. DINING ROOM - NIGHT

The family sits down for dinner. The atmosphere is warm and loving.

LUCY
Mark, I've been thinking. I think we should invite your parents over for dinner. It's been too long since we've seen them.

MARK
(smiling)
That's a great idea. I'll call them right now.

INT. LIVING ROOM - EVENING

Mark and Lucy's parents arrive, and the entire family gathers around the living room for a heartfelt conversation.

MARK
(to his parents)
We've had some issues in our marriage lately, but Lucy and I have decided to work through them. We want to make things right.

MARK'S MOTHER
Mark, we're so proud of you both. We've always believed in your love.

LUCY'S FATHER
And we're here to support you, no matter what.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

Mark and Lucy lie in bed, holding each other. Their love has been rekindled.

MARK
Lucy, I promise to never take you for granted again.

LUCY
I promise the same, Mark.

NARRATOR (V.O.) (Lucy)
And so, we started anew. With forgiveness and love, we built a stronger foundation for our family.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
